description:
Create a new task in HubSpot.
    
    Common properties:
    - hs_task_subject (required)
    - hs_task_body
    - hs_timestamp (due date in ms)
    - hs_task_status (NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED)
    - hs_task_priority (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH)
    - hubspot_owner_id
name: create_hubspot_task
